title: FL-SEHGT: Federated Learning-Based Heterogeneous Graph Transformer with Squeeze-and-Excitation for ASD Identification

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder associated with widespread functional brain changes.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《FL-SEHGT: Federated Learning-Based Heterogeneous Graph Transformer with Squeeze-and-Excitation for ASD Identification》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】To address these challenges, we propose a federated learning-based squeeze-and-excitation heterogeneous graph transformer (FL-SEHGT) that utilizes resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) data to improve diagnostic accuracy relative to the evaluated federated baselines, enhance interpretability, and enable collaborative multi-site training without centralizing raw neuroimaging data.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The 10-site result also surpasses traditional models trained independently at each site (which achieved accuracies of 63.4%, 55.7%, and 60.2%).

evidence.text: To address these challenges, we propose a federated learning-based squeeze-and-excitation heterogeneous graph transformer (FL-SEHGT) that utilizes resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) data to improve diagnostic accuracy relative to the evaluated federated baselines, enhance interpretability, and enable collaborative multi-site training without centralizing raw neuroimaging data.
The 10-site result also surpasses traditional models trained independently at each site (which achieved accuracies of 63.4%, 55.7%, and 60.2%).

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《FL-SEHGT: Federated Learning-Based Heterogeneous Graph Transformer with Squeeze-and-Excitation for ASD Identification》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Although deep learning has advanced computer-aided diagnosis of ASD using neuroimaging data, three key challenges remain: limited classification accuracy due to inadequate feature extraction, underexplored model interpretability that impedes understanding of the underlying neural mechanisms, and privacy concerns over multi-site data sharing that constrain practical deployment of collaborative diagnostic models.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】To address these challenges, we propose a federated learning-based squeeze-and-excitation heterogeneous graph transformer (FL-SEHGT) that utilizes resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) data to improve diagnostic accuracy relative to the evaluated federated baselines, enhance interpretability, and enable collaborative multi-site training without centralizing raw neuroimaging data.

evidence.text: Although deep learning has advanced computer-aided diagnosis of ASD using neuroimaging data, three key challenges remain: limited classification accuracy due to inadequate feature extraction, underexplored model interpretability that impedes understanding of the underlying neural mechanisms, and privacy concerns over multi-site data sharing that constrain practical deployment of collaborative diagnostic models.

To address these challenges, we propose a federated learning-based squeeze-and-excitation heterogeneous graph transformer (FL-SEHGT) that utilizes resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) data to improve diagnostic accuracy relative to the evaluated federated baselines, enhance interpretability, and enable collaborative multi-site training without centralizing raw neuroimaging data.
